mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_agent_model_call_usage FORCE INDEX (idx_agent_usage_settlement) WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_agent_model_request request WHERE request.run_id = afv_agent_model_call_usage.run_id AND request.id = afv_agent_model_call_usage.model_call_id AND request.permit_held = TRUE) AND ( (settlement_status = 'PENDING' AND (next_settlement_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_settlement_attempt_at <= #{now})) OR (settlement_status = 'CLAIMED' AND settlement_claim_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_agent_model_call_usage SET settlement_status = 'CLAIMED', settlement_claim_owner = #{claimOwner}, settlement_claim_until = #{claimUntil}, settlement_attempts = settlement_attempts + 1, next_settlement_attempt_at = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{usageId} AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND ( (settlement_status = 'PENDING' AND (next_settlement_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_settlement_attempt_at <= #{now})) OR (settlement_status = 'CLAIMED' AND settlement_claim_until <= #{now}) )

UPDATE afv_agent_model_call_usage SET settlement_status = 'SETTLED', settlement_claim_owner = NULL, settlement_claim_until = NULL, next_settlement_attempt_at = NULL, downstream_settlement_id = #{downstreamSettlementId}, last_settlement_error = NULL, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{usageId} AND settlement_status = 'CLAIMED' AND settlement_claim_owner = #{claimOwner} AND settlement_claim_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE afv_agent_model_call_usage SET settlement_status = 'PENDING', settlement_claim_owner = NULL, settlement_claim_until = NULL, next_settlement_attempt_at = GREATEST( #{nextAttemptAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), last_settlement_error = #{lastSettlementError}, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{usageId} AND settlement_status = 'CLAIMED' AND settlement_claim_owner = #{claimOwner} AND settlement_claim_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE afv_agent_run r SET r.usage_settled = 1, r.usage_settled_at = #{settledAt}, r.update_time = #{settledAt} WHERE r.run_id = #{runId} AND r.usage_settled = 0 AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM afv_agent_model_call_usage u WHERE u.run_id = r.run_id AND u.settlement_status <> 'SETTLED' )

UPDATE afv_agent_model_call_usage SET status = 'COMPLETED', input_tokens = #{input}, output_tokens = #{output}, reasoning_tokens = NULL, cache_tokens = #{cache}, usage_json = #{usage}, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND model_call_id = #{callId} AND settlement_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE afv_agent_model_call_usage u JOIN afv_agent_model_request m ON m.run_id = u.run_id AND m.id = u.model_call_id SET u.status = 'CANCELLED', u.finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), u.update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE m.id = #{id} AND u.status = 'STARTED'
